context_purpose: An alumni association or partner vendor wants to confirm that a claimant is a genuine alumnus before granting alumni pricing.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting an ID photo, department, graduation year and sometimes a diploma goes well beyond the single fact of alumnus status.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; the vendor only needs alumnus status, though binding to the subscription holder adds a match step a staff glance already handles.

transmission_check.reason: The vendor collects this voluntarily for a discount with no legal duty to keep the full documents.

context_purpose: An insurer or employer wellness administrator wants evidence that a participant spends on fitness so it can grant a premium discount or benefit.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full itemized statements expose pharmacy, clinic and location data that the programme does not need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The aggregate cannot cover other-bank cards, is gameable via coarse merchant codes, and cannot show actual attendance.

transmission_check.reason: Participants voluntarily upload statements to get a discount and no law is known to require the full statements.

context_purpose: A teaching hospital must confirm that a placement student is enrolled and meets health requirements before patient contact.

norm_violation_today.reason: Hospitals have occupational-health duties and may legitimately need vaccine details, so a full vaccination card is not clearly excessive.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The hospital may need specific vaccine and test details for occupational-health decisions, which a same-person eligibility bit cannot supply.

transmission_check.reason: Infection-control rules for clinical staff may require specific records, and I cannot say what Taiwanese regulators mandate.

context_purpose: A promotion operator wants to limit a scarce giveaway to one claim per person to prevent multi-account abuse.

norm_violation_today.reason: A phone number is a normal sign-up identifier, but it also links the account to a person across services beyond what a one-claim check needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Real-name lines are per-line not per-person, and prepaid or corporate lines leave loopholes, so one-per-person is only approximate.

transmission_check.reason: The operator collects the number for fraud screening and marketing with no legal duty, so a nullifier would satisfy the stated purpose.

context_purpose: A housing bureau or social-housing agency wants to check that a rent-subsidy or waitlist applicant is a bona fide low-income occupant of a real dwelling.

norm_violation_today.reason: The agency may legitimately need address and lease details, so collecting them is not clearly excessive.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Eligibility rests on income and asset tests and the lease, which a utility-roll membership bit cannot replace.

transmission_check.reason: Applicants hand documents over for a benefit, but programme rules may require the lease and address and I cannot confirm which.

context_purpose: A school or employer needs to know that a temporary accommodation applies and until when, so it can adjust duties or activities.

norm_violation_today.reason: Diagnosis and treatment plans are kept in the school file long after the accommodation ends, beyond the need for a category and end date.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the verifier loses the diagnostic context and any conversation with the family, which it can still request.

transmission_check.reason: Families volunteer the certificate to obtain the accommodation and no law is known to require the diagnosis to be kept.

context_purpose: A leasing firm wants proof of an active driving record before granting a driver-only lease discount.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full trip exports expose passenger pickup and drop-off addresses and bank details that an experience check does not need.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The lessor also wants earnings for credit risk, which a trip-count threshold does not provide.

transmission_check.reason: The driver volunteers records to get a discount and no law is known to mandate the full export for this lease.

context_purpose: A mediator or court needs reliable evidence of what one party actually paid the other to resolve a dispute over a sum.

norm_violation_today.reason: Full statements expose unrelated transactions, but the party is voluntarily submitting its own records in a dispute where evidence norms differ.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A signed total cannot show timing, individual payments or context, and courts may want bank certificates or discovery rather than proofs.

transmission_check.reason: Evidence rules in mediation and court govern this and I cannot say what Taiwanese procedure accepts beyond bank certificates.
